_comment: Services to validate in a browser, and where their real UI lives.
`path` matters: several services 404 on / while working perfectly on their
actual entry point. tilt-config-server is the example — / returns
{"error":"Not found"} and /config returns 200. Checking / and calling it a
failure would have sent someone hunting a routing bug that does not exist.
`expect` is a case-insensitive substring that must appear in the rendered
page text. A 200 with an empty shell is the failure this whole harness is
for, so asserting on content is the point, not a nicety.
`configKey` is the tilt-config.json flag that enables the service, so a run
can report 'not enabled' distinctly from 'enabled and broken'.

services.name: backstage
services.note: App is branded 'Dev Portal'; expecting 'Backstage' failed a working page.

services.name: hello
services.note: examples/hello-world - the first thing a learner deploys. Always on.

services.name: jenkins
services.note: Jenkins returns HTTP 403 on / when unauthenticated while still serving the login page, so / looks like a failure when it is not. /login returns 200.

services.name: keycloak
services.note: Route host is auth.localhost, not keycloak.localhost.

services.name: kiali
services.note: Istio mesh observability. auth.strategy is anonymous - local dev only.

services.name: localstack
services.note: BLOCKED: chart 0.7.0 requires a LOCALSTACK_AUTH_TOKEN for all installations. Without one the container exits 55 and the route serves 503. Not a routing or migration fault.

services.name: mailhog
services.note: The /api/v2/jim 404 is MailHog's optional chaos monkey, not a fault.

services.name: ollama
services.note: Root returns the plain string 'Ollama is running' - 17 chars, no HTML.

services.name: opencost
services.note: Expect the page heading, not the product name: 'OpenCost' appears only in the logo image and the version footer, outside the text sample.

services.name: prometheus
services.note: Routed since the README had listed this URL for months while nothing served it.

services.name: tilt-config-server
services.note: Serves JSON, not HTML. / has no handler and returns 404 by design.

services.name: wazuh
services.note: Dashboard boots as a JS shell; the title is the only early signal.
